For the first time since 2014, E and I have a HOME. It’s small and we’re (very) slowly building it from the ground up, but it’s OURS 💕

Moving, Day One: Someone has been parked in my assigned spot all morning so I have had to park down the street and hike in laboriously, precariously carrying one box at a time. The furniture will have to wait.
Moving, Day Two: Am sleeping in my bed on my brand new mattress, which I bought to reward myself for carrying my bed up the stairs to my second floor apartment.

Moving, Day Three: Laying pantless on my ugly ass neon orange couch in my brand new living room while I watch my fancy new xfinity cable that I just set up. This is the height of luxury. Life literally does not get better. This is my space, that is mine, and I am at peace.

Moving, Day Four: Am exactly unpacked enough to cook and eat a simple dinner at our table. Am not unpacked enough to know where my can opener is, and resorted to ripping the can of diced tomatoes open with a spoon like the big strong manly bitchbaby I am.
Moving, Day Five: Am now 90% unpacked in the kitchen. Still no sign of the flatware so I am buying some tomorrow, this assuring I will immediately find it upon returning home.
